notes: Tuition fact comes from the programme page quoting the non-EU tuition fee for this programme; the tuition page for non-EU students also lists Engineering Physics among the degree programmes with fees. The application deadline 30 September 2026 is from the DAAD page and is stated for applicants from all countries; the university's own programme page gives the same date for the winter term registration. The application channel is marked as uni-assist VPD because the international applicants page says foreign-earned degrees must have transcripts evaluated via uni-assist; no sentence says applicant applies through uni-assist directly or via an own portal with an explicit statement. Health insurance, visa and accommodation are mentioned but not as admission documents. The pages do not give a programme-specific German language requirement for this programme (German courses are integrated but no level required).
